# Overview

Goal: explore the Big Data Bowl data and get early results and visuals on one question:
**does play-action slow down the pass rush, and does it help the offense (EPA, yards, pressure)?**

Sections:

1. Setup and helper functions
2. Load and prepare data
3. Descriptive comparisons
4. Regression models
5. Model diagnostics
6. Matching
7. Main results
8. Subgroup analyses
9. Robustness checks
10. Save figures

Unless noted, intervals are 95% CIs using **game-clustered robust standard errors**
(`vcovCL`, clustered on `gameId`). The original (classic OLS) intervals are kept
alongside in columns ending in `_classic`.


# 1. Setup

```{r libraries, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lmtest)
library(car)
library(sandwich)
library(lme4)
```

```{r plot-style}
pa_colors <- c("Standard Dropback" = "#999999", "Play-Action" = "#0072B2")

theme_paper <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Helper functions

```{r helpers}
## Game-clustered robust covariance matrix.
## `data` must be the data frame the model was fit on.
cl_vcov <- function(fit, data) {
  rows <- seq_len(nrow(data))
  if (!is.null(fit$na.action)) rows <- rows[-fit$na.action]
  stopifnot(length(rows) == nobs(fit))
  vcovCL(fit, cluster = data$gameId[rows])
}

## Coefficient table with game-clustered standard errors
cl_test <- function(fit, data) coeftest(fit, vcov. = cl_vcov(fit, data))

## Clustered 95% CI for one coefficient, with the classic CI alongside
cl_ci <- function(fit, data, term) {
  clustered <- coefci(fit, parm = term, vcov. = cl_vcov(fit, data))
  classic <- confint(fit)[term, ]
  c(estimate = unname(coef(fit)[term]),
    lower = clustered[1], upper = clustered[2],
    lower_classic = unname(classic[1]), upper_classic = unname(classic[2]))
}

## Play-action coefficient and 95% CIs (clustered and classic) from a fitted model
pa_ci <- function(fit, data) {
  as.data.frame(t(cl_ci(fit, data, "playActionTRUE")))
}

## Fit a model on a subset of plays and return the play-action effect.
## weighted = TRUE uses the matching weights.
pa_effect <- function(data, formula, label, weighted = FALSE) {
  fit <- if (weighted) {
    lm(formula, data = data, weights = weight)
  } else {
    lm(formula, data = data)
  }
  cbind(data.frame(group = label, n_pa = sum(data$playAction)), pa_ci(fit, data))
}

## Add an x-axis label like "1st down\n(1,234 play-action plays)"
add_n_label <- function(effects) {
  effects %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(group, "\n(", format(n_pa, big.mark = ","), " play-action plays)"),
           label = factor(label, levels = label))
}

## Bar chart of play-action EPA effects with 95% CI error bars
effect_bar_plot <- function(effects, bar_width = 0.5) {
  ggplot(effects, aes(x = label, y = estimate)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#0072B2", width = bar_width) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.15,
                  color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    geom_text(aes(y = pmax(upper, 0), label = round(estimate, 2)),
              vjust = -0.6, family = "serif") +
    labs(x = NULL,
         y = "EPA gained per dropback from play-action (95% CI)") +
    theme_paper
}

## Odds ratios with 95% CIs (clustered and classic) for a logistic model
or_table <- function(model, data) {
  clustered <- coefci(model, vcov. = cl_vcov(model, data))
  classic <- confint.default(model)
  out <- exp(cbind(OR = coef(model),
                   lower = clustered[, 1], upper = clustered[, 2],
                   lower_classic = classic[, 1], upper_classic = classic[, 2]))
  round(out, 3)
}

## Weighted mean and its standard error
wmean_se <- function(x, w) {
  ok <- !is.na(x)
  x <- x[ok]
  w <- w[ok]
  m <- weighted.mean(x, w)
  se <- sqrt(sum(w^2 * (x - m)^2)) / sum(w)
  c(mean = m, se = se)
}

## Control variables used in almost every model
controls <- "factor(down) + yardsToGo + absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff"
```


# 2. Load and prepare data

```{r load-data}
plays       <- read.csv("big-data-bowl-data/plays.csv")
player_play <- read.csv("big-data-bowl-data/player_play.csv")
players     <- read.csv("big-data-bowl-data/players.csv")
games       <- read.csv("big-data-bowl-data/games.csv")
```

```{r filter-plays}
## Score differential from the offense's point of view
plays <- plays %>%
  left_join(games %>% select(gameId, homeTeamAbbr), by = "gameId") %>%
  mutate(score_diff = ifelse(possessionTeam == homeTeamAbbr,
                             preSnapHomeScore - preSnapVisitorScore,
                             preSnapVisitorScore - preSnapHomeScore))

## Dropbacks on downs 1-3, 10 yards or less to go, no spikes,
## no plays wiped out by penalty, no overtime, no 4th-quarter garbage time
pass_plays <- plays %>%
  filter(isDropback == TRUE,
         down %in% c(1, 2, 3),
         yardsToGo <= 10,
         qbSpike == FALSE,
         playNullifiedByPenalty == "N",
         quarter <= 4,
         !(quarter == 4 & abs(score_diff) > 16))

nrow(pass_plays)
```

```{r rusher-stats}
## Per-play pass rush stats for the initial pass rushers
rusher_stats <- player_play %>%
  filter(wasInitialPassRusher == 1) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarize(n_rushers = n(),
            avg_getoff = mean(getOffTimeAsPassRusher, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_time_to_pressure = mean(timeToPressureAsPassRusher, na.rm = TRUE),
            ## NOTE: returns -Inf (with a warning) if every rusher on a play is NA
            any_pressure = max(causedPressure, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

## Get-off for defensive linemen only
dl_stats <- player_play %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(nflId, position), by = "nflId") %>%
  filter(wasInitialPassRusher == 1, position %in% c("DE", "DT", "NT")) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarize(dl_getoff = mean(getOffTimeAsPassRusher, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r model-data}
model_data <- pass_plays %>%
  left_join(rusher_stats, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(dl_stats, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  mutate(sack = ifelse(passResult == "S", 1, 0),
         play_type = factor(ifelse(playAction, "Play-Action", "Standard Dropback"),
                            levels = c("Standard Dropback", "Play-Action")))

dim(model_data)
```


# 3. Descriptive comparisons

```{r describe-play-types}
## Play-action vs. standard dropbacks
model_data %>%
  group_by(playAction) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean_epa = mean(expectedPointsAdded, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_yards = mean(yardsGained, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_getoff = mean(avg_getoff, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_rushers = mean(n_rushers, na.rm = TRUE),
            missing_getoff = sum(is.nan(avg_getoff) | is.na(avg_getoff)),
            pressure_rate = mean(any_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
            sack_rate = mean(sack, na.rm = TRUE),
            int_rate = mean(passResult == "IN", na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r fig-getoff-boxplot}
## Figure 1: Pass Rushers Get Off the Line Slower on Play-Action
p1 <- ggplot(model_data, aes(x = play_type, y = avg_getoff, fill = play_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pa_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Average get-off time (seconds)") +
  theme_paper
p1
```

```{r fig-pressure-by-down}
## Figure 2: Play-Action Draws More Pressure on 1st and 2nd Down but Less on 3rd Down
p4 <- model_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(any_pressure)) %>%
  group_by(down, play_type) %>%
  summarize(pressure_rate = mean(any_pressure), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(down), y = pressure_rate, fill = play_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pa_colors) +
  labs(x = "Down", y = "Share of dropbacks with pressure", fill = NULL) +
  theme_paper
p4
```

```{r fig-team-getoff, fig.height=7}
## Every Defense Gets Off the Line Slower on Play-Action
team_getoff <- model_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_getoff)) %>%
  group_by(defensiveTeam, play_type) %>%
  summarize(mean_getoff = mean(avg_getoff), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = play_type, values_from = mean_getoff) %>%
  mutate(gap = `Play-Action` - `Standard Dropback`) %>%
  arrange(gap) %>%
  mutate(defensiveTeam = factor(defensiveTeam, levels = defensiveTeam))

ggplot(team_getoff, aes(y = defensiveTeam)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = `Standard Dropback`, xend = `Play-Action`, yend = defensiveTeam),
               color = "#999999") +
  geom_point(aes(x = `Standard Dropback`, color = "Standard Dropback", shape = "Standard Dropback"),
             size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = `Play-Action`, color = "Play-Action", shape = "Play-Action"),
             size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pa_colors, breaks = c("Standard Dropback", "Play-Action")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Standard Dropback" = 15, "Play-Action" = 16),
                     breaks = c("Standard Dropback", "Play-Action")) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 1.2)) +
  labs(title = "Every Defense Gets Off the Line Slower on Play-Action",
       x = "Average get-off time (seconds)",
       y = NULL, color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_paper +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
```


# 4. Regression models

All models control for down, distance, field position and score. Each `summary()` (classic
standard errors) is followed by `cl_test()`, the same model with game-clustered standard errors.

```{r models-getoff}
## Does play-action slow the pass rush?
getoff_model <- lm(as.formula(paste("avg_getoff ~ playAction +", controls)),
                   data = model_data)
summary(getoff_model)
cl_test(getoff_model, model_data)

## Same, also controlling for the number of rushers
getoff_model2 <- lm(as.formula(paste("avg_getoff ~ playAction + n_rushers +", controls)),
                    data = model_data)
summary(getoff_model2)
cl_test(getoff_model2, model_data)

## Defensive linemen only
dl_model <- lm(as.formula(paste("dl_getoff ~ playAction +", controls)),
               data = model_data)
summary(dl_model)
cl_test(dl_model, model_data)
```

```{r models-offense}
## Does play-action help the offense?
epa_model <- lm(as.formula(paste("expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction +", controls)),
                data = model_data)
summary(epa_model)
cl_test(epa_model, model_data)
cl_ci(epa_model, model_data, "playActionTRUE")

yards_model <- lm(as.formula(paste("yardsGained ~ playAction +", controls)),
                  data = model_data)
summary(yards_model)
cl_test(yards_model, model_data)
cl_ci(yards_model, model_data, "playActionTRUE")

## Does slower get-off go with higher EPA?
link_model <- lm(as.formula(paste("expectedPointsAdded ~ avg_getoff + playAction +", controls)),
                 data = model_data)
summary(link_model)
cl_test(link_model, model_data)
```

```{r models-pressure}
## Does play-action lower the chance of pressure?
pressure_model <- glm(as.formula(paste("any_pressure ~ playAction +", controls)),
                      data = model_data, family = binomial)
summary(pressure_model)
cl_test(pressure_model, model_data)

## Does slower get-off go with less pressure?
getoff_pressure <- glm(as.formula(paste("any_pressure ~ avg_getoff + playAction +", controls)),
                       data = model_data, family = binomial)
summary(getoff_pressure)
cl_test(getoff_pressure, model_data)
```

```{r fig-getoff-pressure}
## Figure 3: Slower Get-Off Goes With Less Pressure
p2 <- model_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_getoff), !is.na(any_pressure)) %>%
  mutate(getoff_group = ntile(avg_getoff, 5)) %>%
  group_by(getoff_group) %>%
  summarize(mean_getoff = mean(avg_getoff),
            pressure_rate = mean(any_pressure), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_getoff, y = pressure_rate)) +
  geom_line(color = "#0072B2") +
  geom_point(color = "#0072B2", size = 3) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "Average get-off time in group (seconds)",
       y = "Share of dropbacks with pressure") +
  theme_paper
p2
```


# 5. Model diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
## Constant variance (Breusch-Pagan) and multicollinearity (VIF)
bptest(getoff_model)
bptest(epa_model)
vif(getoff_model)
vif(epa_model)

## Residual plots
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(getoff_model)
plot(epa_model)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

## Robust standard errors (use these if Breusch-Pagan flags uneven variance)
coeftest(getoff_model, vcov = vcovHC(getoff_model, type = "HC3"))
coeftest(epa_model, vcov = vcovHC(epa_model, type = "HC3"))
```


# 6. Matching

Group plays by down, distance, field position and score. Keep only groups that have both
play types, and weight the standard dropbacks so each group matches its play-action count.

```{r matching}
match_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(dist_group = cut(yardsToGo, breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 10),
                          labels = c("1-3", "4-6", "7-10")),
         field_group = ntile(absoluteYardlineNumber, 4),
         score_group = cut(score_diff, breaks = c(-Inf, -9, -1, 8, Inf),
                           labels = c("Down 9+", "Down 1-8", "Tied or up 1-8", "Up 9+")))

cells <- match_data %>%
  group_by(down, dist_group, field_group, score_group) %>%
  summarize(n_pa = sum(playAction), n_std = sum(!playAction), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_pa > 0, n_std > 0)

matched <- match_data %>%
  inner_join(cells, by = c("down", "dist_group", "field_group", "score_group")) %>%
  mutate(weight = ifelse(playAction, 1, n_pa / n_std))

## Plays kept (FALSE = standard, TRUE = play-action)
table(match_data$playAction)
table(matched$playAction)
```

```{r balance-check}
## Are the two play types more similar after matching?
match_data %>%
  group_by(playAction) %>%
  summarize(yardsToGo = mean(yardsToGo),
            field_pos = mean(absoluteYardlineNumber),
            score_diff = mean(score_diff),
            first_down = mean(down == 1))

matched %>%
  group_by(playAction) %>%
  summarize(yardsToGo = weighted.mean(yardsToGo, weight),
            field_pos = weighted.mean(absoluteYardlineNumber, weight),
            score_diff = weighted.mean(score_diff, weight),
            first_down = weighted.mean(down == 1, weight))
```

```{r matched-models}
getoff_matched <- lm(as.formula(paste("avg_getoff ~ playAction +", controls)),
                     data = matched, weights = weight)
summary(getoff_matched)
cl_test(getoff_matched, matched)

epa_matched <- lm(as.formula(paste("expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction +", controls)),
                  data = matched, weights = weight)
summary(epa_matched)
cl_test(epa_matched, matched)
cl_ci(epa_matched, matched, "playActionTRUE")

yards_matched <- lm(as.formula(paste("yardsGained ~ playAction +", controls)),
                    data = matched, weights = weight)
summary(yards_matched)
cl_test(yards_matched, matched)
```


# 7. Main results

```{r results-table}
## Table 1. Play-action effect: regression vs. matched.
## Lower/Upper = game-clustered 95% CI; *_classic = original OLS 95% CI
results_row <- function(model, data, outcome, method) {
  est <- pa_ci(model, data)
  data.frame(Outcome = outcome, Method = method,
             Estimate = round(est$estimate, 3),
             Lower = round(est$lower, 3),
             Upper = round(est$upper, 3),
             Lower_classic = round(est$lower_classic, 3),
             Upper_classic = round(est$upper_classic, 3))
}

results_table <- rbind(
  results_row(getoff_model,   model_data, "Get-off time (seconds)", "Regression"),
  results_row(getoff_matched, matched,    "Get-off time (seconds)", "Matched"),
  results_row(epa_model,      model_data, "EPA per dropback",       "Regression"),
  results_row(epa_matched,    matched,    "EPA per dropback",       "Matched"),
  results_row(yards_model,    model_data, "Yards per dropback",     "Regression"),
  results_row(yards_matched,  matched,    "Yards per dropback",     "Matched")
)
results_table
```

```{r odds-ratios}
## Pressure results as odds ratios (lower/upper = clustered, *_classic = original)
or_table(pressure_model, model_data)
or_table(getoff_pressure, model_data)

## Effect of a 0.1 second slower get-off on the odds of pressure
exp(coef(getoff_pressure)["avg_getoff"] * 0.1)
```

```{r fig-epa-effect}
## Figure 4: Play-Action Shows a Small EPA Gain Under Both Methods
epa_plot_data <- results_table %>%
  filter(Outcome == "EPA per dropback")

p3 <- ggplot(epa_plot_data, aes(x = Estimate, y = Method)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), color = "#0072B2", size = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Difference in EPA per dropback, play-action minus standard (95% CI)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_paper
p3
```


# 8. Subgroup analyses

## Get-off effect by down

```{r getoff-by-down}
## Within a single down, drop factor(down) from the controls
f_getoff_all <- as.formula(paste("avg_getoff ~ playAction +", controls))
f_getoff_one <- avg_getoff ~ playAction + yardsToGo + absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff

getoff_effects <- rbind(
  pa_effect(model_data, f_getoff_all, "All plays"),
  pa_effect(filter(model_data, down == 1), f_getoff_one, "1st down"),
  pa_effect(filter(model_data, down == 2), f_getoff_one, "2nd down"),
  pa_effect(filter(model_data, down == 3), f_getoff_one, "3rd down")
) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("3rd down", "2nd down", "1st down", "All plays")))
getoff_effects

ggplot(getoff_effects, aes(x = estimate, y = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), color = "#0072B2", size = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(estimate, 2), " sec")),
            vjust = -1.2, family = "serif") +
  labs(title = "Play-Action Slows the Pass Rush on Every Down",
       x = "Slower get-off on play-action (seconds, 95% CI)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_paper
```

## EPA effect by down (matched plays)

```{r epa-by-down}
f_epa_all <- as.formula(paste("expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction +", controls))
f_epa_one <- expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction + yardsToGo + absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff

epa_effects <- rbind(
  pa_effect(matched, f_epa_all, "All plays", weighted = TRUE),
  pa_effect(filter(matched, down == 1), f_epa_one, "1st down", weighted = TRUE),
  pa_effect(filter(matched, down >= 2), f_epa_all, "2nd and 3rd down", weighted = TRUE)
) %>%
  add_n_label()
epa_effects

p_epa3 <- effect_bar_plot(epa_effects, bar_width = 0.55)
p_epa3

## Is the play-action effect bigger on 1st down than on 2nd/3rd down?
first_down_model <- lm(expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction * first_down + yardsToGo +
                         absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                       data = mutate(matched, first_down = down == 1), weights = weight)
summary(first_down_model)
cl_test(first_down_model, matched)
cl_ci(first_down_model, matched, "playActionTRUE:first_downTRUE")
```

## EPA effect by distance (matched plays)

```{r epa-by-distance}
## How often do offenses pass, by down and distance? (all plays, runs included)
## qbSpike is NA on every run play, so treat NA as "not a spike"/"not a kneel";
## otherwise the filter drops all runs and every pass rate is 1.
all_downs <- plays %>%
  filter(down %in% c(1, 2, 3),
         coalesce(qbKneel, 0L) == 0,
         !coalesce(qbSpike, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(dist_group = cut(yardsToGo, breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 10, Inf),
                          labels = c("1-3", "4-6", "7-10", "11+")))

## Check that run plays are kept
count(all_downs, isDropback)

all_downs %>%
  group_by(down, dist_group) %>%
  summarize(plays = n(), pass_rate = round(mean(isDropback == TRUE), 3), .groups = "drop")

## First-down pass rate
all_downs %>%
  filter(down == 1) %>%
  summarize(plays = n(), pass_rate = round(mean(isDropback == TRUE), 3))

## Play-action plays in each down and distance group
matched %>%
  filter(playAction) %>%
  count(down, dist_group)

## Play-action effect on EPA within each distance group
f_epa_dist <- expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction + factor(down) + absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff

dist_effects <- bind_rows(lapply(c("1-3", "4-6", "7-10"), function(g) {
  pa_effect(filter(matched, dist_group == g), f_epa_dist, g, weighted = TRUE)
})) %>%
  rename(distance = group) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, starts_with("lower"), starts_with("upper")), ~ round(.x, 3)))
dist_effects
```


```{r}
## Figure 2: Play-Action Slows the Pass Rush on Every Down
p_getoff_down <- ggplot(getoff_effects, aes(x = estimate, y = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
                  color = "#0072B2", size = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(estimate, 2), " sec")),
            vjust = -1.2, family = "serif") +
  labs(x = "Slower get-off on play-action (seconds, 95% CI)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_paper

p_getoff_down
ggsave("figures/fig_getoff_by_down.png", p_getoff_down,
       width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```


## 1st down vs. 3rd and short (matched plays)

```{r first-vs-third-short}
first_down  <- filter(matched, down == 1)
third_short <- filter(matched, down == 3, yardsToGo <= 3)

## Plays in each group (FALSE = standard, TRUE = play-action)
table(first_down$playAction)
table(third_short$playAction)

short_effects <- rbind(
  pa_effect(first_down,  f_epa_one, "1st down", weighted = TRUE),
  pa_effect(third_short, f_epa_one, "3rd and short (3 yards or less)", weighted = TRUE)
) %>%
  add_n_label()
short_effects

p_short <- effect_bar_plot(short_effects)
p_short

## Is the play-action effect different in the two groups?
both <- bind_rows(mutate(first_down, grp = "first"),
                  mutate(third_short, grp = "third_short"))

compare_model <- lm(expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction * grp + yardsToGo +
                      absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                    data = both, weights = weight)
summary(compare_model)
cl_test(compare_model, both)
cl_ci(compare_model, both, "playActionTRUE:grpthird_short")
```

## Pressure and EPA (matched plays)

```{r pressure-epa}
## Does pressure cost EPA?
pressure_epa_model <- lm(as.formula(paste("expectedPointsAdded ~ any_pressure + playAction +", controls)),
                         data = matched, weights = weight)
summary(pressure_epa_model)
cl_test(pressure_epa_model, matched)
cl_ci(pressure_epa_model, matched, "any_pressure")

## Mediation check: does play-action's EPA effect shrink once pressure is in the model?
## Without pressure in the model:
coef(epa_matched)["playActionTRUE"]
## With pressure in the model:
summary(pressure_epa_model)$coefficients["playActionTRUE", ]
cl_ci(pressure_epa_model, matched, "playActionTRUE")

## Share of dropbacks pressured by play type
matched %>%
  filter(!is.na(any_pressure)) %>%
  group_by(play_type) %>%
  summarize(pressure_rate = weighted.mean(any_pressure, weight))

## Average EPA by pressure and play type
epa_pressure <- matched %>%
  filter(!is.na(any_pressure)) %>%
  mutate(pressure_label = ifelse(any_pressure == 1, "Pressured", "Not pressured")) %>%
  group_by(pressure_label, play_type) %>%
  summarize(plays = n(),
            mean_epa = wmean_se(expectedPointsAdded, weight)["mean"],
            se = wmean_se(expectedPointsAdded, weight)["se"],
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pressure_label = factor(pressure_label, levels = c("Not pressured", "Pressured")))
epa_pressure

p_pressure_epa <- ggplot(epa_pressure, aes(x = pressure_label, y = mean_epa, fill = play_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_epa - 1.96 * se, ymax = mean_epa + 1.96 * se),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2,
                color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pa_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Average EPA per dropback (95% CI)", fill = NULL) +
  theme_paper
p_pressure_epa
```

```{r epa-by-pressure}
## Play-action EPA effect when pressured vs. not
matched_p <- matched %>% filter(!is.na(any_pressure))

pressure_effects <- rbind(
  pa_effect(filter(matched_p, any_pressure == 0), f_epa_all, "Not pressured", weighted = TRUE),
  pa_effect(filter(matched_p, any_pressure == 1), f_epa_all, "Pressured", weighted = TRUE)
) %>%
  add_n_label()
pressure_effects

p_press_eff <- effect_bar_plot(pressure_effects)
p_press_eff

## Does play-action's effect differ when pressured vs. not?
inter_pressure <- lm(as.formula(paste("expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction * any_pressure +", controls)),
                     data = matched_p, weights = weight)
summary(inter_pressure)
cl_test(inter_pressure, matched_p)
cl_ci(inter_pressure, matched_p, "playActionTRUE:any_pressure")
```


# 9. Robustness checks

## Random effects for game and defense

Instead of clustering, model game-level and defense-level differences directly with
random intercepts, `(1 | gameId)` and `(1 | defensiveTeam)`.

```{r random-effects}
re_formula <- function(outcome) {
  as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ playAction +", controls, "+ (1 | gameId) + (1 | defensiveTeam)"))
}

getoff_re <- lmer(re_formula("avg_getoff"), data = model_data)
epa_re    <- lmer(re_formula("expectedPointsAdded"), data = model_data)
summary(getoff_re)
summary(epa_re)

## Play-action effect: fixed-effect regression vs. random-effects model
re_row <- function(model, outcome, method) {
  ci <- confint(model, parm = "playActionTRUE", method = "Wald")
  data.frame(Outcome = outcome, Method = method,
             Estimate = round(unname(fixef(model)["playActionTRUE"]), 3),
             Lower = round(ci[1], 3), Upper = round(ci[2], 3))
}

rbind(
  results_row(getoff_model, model_data, "Get-off time (seconds)", "Regression (clustered SE)")[, 1:5],
  re_row(getoff_re, "Get-off time (seconds)", "Random effects"),
  results_row(epa_model, model_data, "EPA per dropback", "Regression (clustered SE)")[, 1:5],
  re_row(epa_re, "EPA per dropback", "Random effects")
)
```

## EPA outliers

EPA has long tails (big plays, turnovers). Re-run the main EPA models after dropping the
most extreme plays. The cutoffs are set on the full `model_data` and applied to both samples.

```{r epa-outliers}
quantile(model_data$expectedPointsAdded, c(0, 0.01, 0.025, 0.5, 0.975, 0.99, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

trim_epa <- function(data, tail) {
  cut <- quantile(model_data$expectedPointsAdded, c(tail, 1 - tail), na.rm = TRUE)
  filter(data, between(expectedPointsAdded, cut[1], cut[2]))
}

f_epa <- as.formula(paste("expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction +", controls))

outlier_row <- function(sample_label, tail) {
  reg <- if (tail == 0) model_data else trim_epa(model_data, tail)
  mat <- if (tail == 0) matched    else trim_epa(matched, tail)
  rbind(
    cbind(Model = "Regression", Sample = sample_label, n = nrow(reg),
          pa_ci(lm(f_epa, data = reg), reg)),
    cbind(Model = "Matched", Sample = sample_label, n = nrow(mat),
          pa_ci(lm(f_epa, data = mat, weights = weight), mat))
  )
}

epa_outliers <- rbind(
  outlier_row("All plays", 0),
  outlier_row("Drop top/bottom 1%", 0.01),
  outlier_row("Drop top/bottom 2.5%", 0.025)
) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, starts_with("lower"), starts_with("upper")), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  arrange(Model)
epa_outliers
```
